## Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for all three children.

Here's the breakdown:

### **Alex (4 years old) - ELIGIBLE** ✓
Alex meets all the standard requirements as a child under 16 living with you. Even though Alex has been in hospital for 10 weeks, you remain eligible because Child Benefit continues for up to 12 weeks when a child is in hospital. Since Alex has been hospitalized for less than the 12-week limit, your eligibility continues.

### **Blake (16 years old) - ELIGIBLE** ✓
Although Blake doesn't live with you, you can still claim Child Benefit because:
- Blake left education/training and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or armed services less than 20 weeks ago (Child Benefit can continue for up to 20 weeks in this situation)
- You contribute £50/week towards Blake's upkeep, which exceeds the Child Benefit payment amount
- No other claimant has priority

### **Charlie (15 years old) - ELIGIBLE** ✓
Charlie meets all the standard eligibility criteria as a child under 16 who lives with you in the UK.

**Important notes:**
- Only one person can claim Child Benefit for each child
- Be aware of the High Income Child Benefit tax charge if you or your partner earn over £60,000
- For Blake, the 20-week eligibility period will eventually expire, so keep track of when that period ends

You should proceed with your Child Benefit application or ensure your claims are up to date!
